report_command_description: Open my report or select a service profile
yandex_ocr_api_key_description: Key used to recognize receipt dates
yandex_ocr_folder_id_description: Folder identifier used by Yandex OCR
yandex_ai_studio_api_key_description: Private API key for image classification and receipt Vision. When both this key and the AI Studio folder ID are set, AI Studio is used instead of OpenAI
yandex_ai_studio_folder_id_description: Folder that owns the AI Studio model and API key
yandex_ai_studio_model_description: Model ID without the folder prefix. Default: qwen3.6-35b-a3b
openai_receipt_api_key_label: OpenAI API key for receipt checks
openai_receipt_api_key_description: Optional. Used together with Yandex OCR as a second layer for receipt date, amount, status, and readable text checks
openai_receipt_model_description: Example: gpt-4.1-mini. If empty, gpt-4.1-mini is used
image_classification_v1_shadow_enabled_d: Off by default. Runs a privacy-safe comparison without changing image routing or TARS decisions
scanner2_shadow_mode_description: OFF by default. RECORD_ONLY stores privacy-safe structured observations without changing TARS decisions
scanner2_shadow_hmac_secret_description: Private secret of at least 32 bytes used only to tokenize shadow records
scanner2_shadow_token_key_version_descri: Short key rotation label, for example k1
scanner2_shadow_sample_percent_descripti: Deterministic percentage of anonymous cases recorded in RECORD_ONLY. Default 0 disables writes
scanner2_shadow_retention_days_descripti: Keep anonymous shadow records for 1 to 90 days. Default 30
scanner2_shadow_max_records_description: Bound the anonymous shadow dataset to 100 through 50000 records. Default 5000
receipt_timezone_description: GSNV Lab workday time zone: Europe/Astrakhan
receipt_workday_cutoff_description: Before this hour a receipt belongs to the previous workday
receipt_owner_username_description: Owner added to every master's private cash room
receipt_admin_username_description: User added with the owner to every master's private cash room
receipt_result_room_description: Channel where accepted receipts are published without images
master_private_chat_usernames_descriptio: Comma-separated or one per line: narek, dariaaa, shura. /tarschat all creates tars-username rooms.
master_private_chat_prefix_description: Example: tars-. The room for dariaaa will be tars-dariaaa.
receipt_archive_enabled_description: Store independent receipt copies in a private Rocket.Chat room before cash-room deletion
receipt_archive_bucket_description: Private bucket used for external receipt backups
receipt_archive_access_key_description: Static access key identifier for the service account allowed to write to the bucket
receipt_archive_secret_key_description: Static secret stored only in the private app settings
receipt_archive_command_description: Show receipts from the private archive; owner and Shura only
schedule_command_description: Mark a master as off or working for a specific date; monthly schedule is sent as text in a direct chat with Tars
master_chat_command_description: Create or verify private TARS chats for masters
lateness_command_description: Record a master's lateness and payroll penalty
approve_receipt_command_description: Manually approve a rejected receipt (e.g. one stuck in "processing" status); owner and Shura only
